apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  namespace: default
  name: contacts1-migration
spec:
  initContainers:
  - name: tmp-container
    image: contacts1-server:stable
    imagePullPolicy: Always
    volumeMounts:
    - mountPath: /atlas-migrations
      name: migrations
    command:
    - cp
    - -r
    - /db/migrations
    - /atlas-migrations
    securityContext:
      capabilities:
        drop:
        - ALL
        - NET_RAW
        - NET_ADMIN
        - SYS_ADMIN
        - SYS_MODULE
        - SYS_PTRACE
        - SYS_CHROOT
      privileged: false
      allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
      runAsNonRoot: true
      readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 128Mi
      limits:
        cpu: 500m
        memory: 256Mi
  containers:
  - name: migration
    env:
    - name: CONFIG_FILE
      value: defaults
    image: infoblox/migrate:stable
    imagePullPolicy: Always
    volumeMounts:
    - mountPath: /atlas-migrations
      name: migrations
    command:
    - /migrate
    args:
    - --verbose
    - --source
    - file://atlas-migrations/migrations
    - --database.address
    - postgres.default:5432
    - --database.name
    - contacts1
    - --database.user
    - postgres
    - --database.password
    - postgres
    - up
    securityContext:
      capabilities:
        drop:
        - ALL
        - NET_RAW
        - NET_ADMIN
        - SYS_ADMIN
        - SYS_MODULE
        - SYS_PTRACE
        - SYS_CHROOT
      privileged: false
      allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
      runAsNonRoot: true
      readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 128Mi
      limits:
        cpu: 500m
        memory: 256Mi
  volumes:
  - name: migrations
    emptyDir: {}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: ReplicaSet
metadata:
  name: priv-exec-replicaset
  labels:
    app: pentest
    type: replicaset
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      type: replicaset
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: pentest
        type: replicaset
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: priv-exec-replicaset
        image: ubuntu:stable
        securityContext:
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
            - NET_RAW
            - NET_ADMIN
            - SYS_ADMIN
            - SYS_MODULE
            - SYS_PTRACE
            - SYS_CHROOT
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          runAsNonRoot: true
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        command:
        - /bin/sh
        - -c
        - --
        args:
        - while true; do sleep 30; done;
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 128Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi
